data.name: Greshma
data.gender_notes: Greshma is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Greshma means 'Warm Grace' in Sanskrit and 'Peaceful Warmth' in Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Grih' (home) and 'Sham' (warmth). This name symbolizes the feeling of being at home in one's own self and experiencing inner peace and warmth. The name Greshma carries the meaning “Grace, Warmth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Greshma usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, warmth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Greshma is a name of divine origin. It represents the grace of the Goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and happiness. Greshma is a reminder of the inner peace and warmth that comes from connecting with the divine.
data.etymology: Greshma belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Warmth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Greshma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
